scope: general-purpose smooth ODE solver; excludes BASS/rei physics and specialized application acceptance criteria
evidence_policy: Reuse published unchanged results once; source-bound evidence is not recertification of modified code. No NCP.

search.not_claimed: statistical Monte Carlo tree search or exhaustive global optimization

candidates.policy: automatic broad switching by stiffness pressure
candidates.reason: same evidence includes severe FD/transition regressions; no future-horizon guarantee

candidates.policy: capability-first explicit DOPRI5 or protected RODAS5P from declared problem and derivative policy
candidates.reason: smallest core with demonstrated complementary stiff/nonstiff roles; fail instead of inventing capability

candidates.policy: enable causal, quotient, polynomial or homotopy whenever approximate structure detected
candidates.reason: structure and cost are unproved for arbitrary callbacks; current benefits have narrow domains

selection_contract.unknown_problem: DOPRI5 may be a budgeted RHS-only trial; finite failure is not stiffness diagnosis and does not authorize derivatives.
selection_contract.nonstiff: DOPRI5; no Jacobian, matrix factorization or Newton iterations.
selection_contract.stiff: Protected RODAS5P with explicitly permitted derivative route and current facade capabilities; reject when unavailable.
selection_contract.structured_specialization: Explicit separate API, current structure witness and same-error measured benefit; never inferred only from a few RHS probes.
selection_contract.events_mass_dense: Use exact current capability checks. General selector must not advertise unsupported combinations or online terminal-event semantics.
selection_contract.compatibility: Existing methods remain callable; classification removes automatic/mainline adoption, not archival evidence or references.
selection_contract.ordinary_accuracy_contract: Local tolerance/error estimates plus documented sampling; no universal global-error promise.
selection_contract.production_qualification: Qualify the promised endpoint identity-mass surface from current-code robustness/error evidence and failure contracts. Events, dense output, mass/DAE, persistent resume and global certificates are optional when explicitly refused or excluded; BASS/rei/PDE physics is not a release prerequisite.
selection_contract.implemented_surface: GeneralOde selects DOPRI5 or protected RODAS5P; rejects mass, events and dense_output; default Unknown/derivatives Forbidden/dense resource ceiling64/matrix-free disabled. Ceiling64 is policy, not measured crossover.

families.name: DOPRI5 embedded 5(4)
families.scope: Declared nonstiff; unknown only as explicitly budgeted trial, not qualified stiff solve.
families.reason: RHS-only path avoids all Jacobian, matrix and Newton work; selected nonstiff smooth forward identity-mass scope has actual-error evidence.
families.next_action: Complete public persistent-session integration; exercise discontinuity reset and finite-budget failure; preserve FSAL invalidation.
families.performance: 90 configurations / 360 runs; local native RODAS comparison 2.73–8.93x at sampled cap 1e-6; stiff negative control requires 186085 RHS calls and is about277x slower than RODAS.

families.name: Protected RODAS5P dense; sequential compatibility API
families.scope: New selector: smooth stiff identity-mass endpoint ODEs with supported atol and authorized derivatives. Existing sequential/mass/dense-output methods remain separate method-specific compatibility APIs, not the selected surface.
families.reason: Existing protected fallback has the widest implicit capability surface. Finite-difference Jacobians are derivative approximations and form matrices; they are not derivative-free.
families.next_action: Bind selected route to current facade capability report and explicit derivative policy; surface early native fatal failures and partial results consistently.

families.name: RODAS5P declared-band direct solve
families.scope: User-declared correct band structure and supported output contract.
families.reason: Band declarations can reduce factorization work; the declaration must be correct and no O(N) claim is valid unless bandwidth is bounded.
families.next_action: Reject incompatible vector-atol/mass/dense combinations using existing capabilities; benchmark with fixed dimension and increasing bandwidth.

families.name: RODAS5P supplied-JVP GMRES/LGMRES/GCRODR
families.scope: Supplied authorized JVP; only facade-supported combinations. No unconditional stiff large-N speed claim.
families.reason: Avoids forming the full Jacobian, but still uses derivative actions and Krylov basis storage. These are not matrix-free in the sense of having no auxiliary matrices.
families.next_action: Retain residual verification and fail-safe iteration limits; profile preconditioned and unpreconditioned costs before selecting by dimension.

families.name: Compile-time small-N RODAS5P
families.scope: Compile-time dimension; user-selected static layout.
families.reason: Useful specialized layout without evidence of a universal size threshold or current winner for every callback.
families.next_action: Measure complete solve including setup against protected dense at fixed actual-error cap; retain only winning declared sizes.

families.name: Pressure / bounded-pilot explicit-implicit switching
families.scope: Experimental opt-in; authorized derivatives; fixed endpoint semantics.
families.reason: Pilot fixes one regime while penalizing others; persistent native sessions now exist but are not fully connected to switching.
families.next_action: Wire checkpoint/session ownership; include all failed/pilot work; require future-horizon break-even evidence before enabling automatic entry.
families.performance: Rapid JVP about9.46x better than old pilot-free switch, rapid FD about2.03x slower and transition FD about3.05x slower; 105/120 rows pass common cap1e-5.

families.name: Lawson DOPRI5 generic residual
families.scope: Declared constant damped-rotation split; no arbitrary-matrix exact-action claim.
families.reason: Splitting algebra alone does not pay for extra transforms; generic forcing and slow cases can lose badly. Latest long-cycle timing is explicitly inconclusive.
families.next_action: Only reopen for a declared cheap exact linear action and measured small residual, with endpoint/phase errors and all transforms counted.
families.performance: Latest cyclic36/36 pass sampled caps but timing_authority=diagnostic_only; no speed promotion.

families.name: Affine quotient Lawson / exact harmonic endpoint
families.scope: Fixed damped-rotation blocks, constant affine forcing or declared fixed harmonic forcing.
families.reason: Constant affine and harmonic structure admits cheap entire-function actions; that structure is user evidence, not inferred from arbitrary RHS samples.
families.next_action: Require fixed provider/parameter epoch and declared forcing type; benchmark setup-inclusive selected domain versus strongest direct exact action.
families.performance: Prior affine/full-RHS ratios4.36x,22.71x,1.58x on selected stiff/rapid/shared128 cases; losses4.25x zero,5.09x slow and44.58x generic forcing prohibit automatic adoption. Latest LP01 timings remain inconclusive.

families.name: Projected augmented causal forward RODAS
families.scope: Autonomous identity-mass endpoint-observed ODEs with supplied base JVP and valid projected residual check.
families.reason: Causality permits common-factor triangular elimination with no current-stage Newton/JVP; supplied base JVP, projection and original residual fallback remain.
families.next_action: Compare complete trajectories against protected dense and best supplied-JVP driver, not only residual-first coupled baseline; quantify projection/fallback crossover.
families.performance: 6/7 groups1.17–2.79x versus residual-first; broad group0.99856x with33/35fallbacks. Earlier coupled-vs-economy few-mode ratio0.422 shows why baseline identity matters.

families.name: Parallel causal Picard / residual-first schedules
families.scope: Research expensive-RHS crossover; residual-first remains regression/control.
families.reason: Serial forward is faster on all seven eligible groups. Two threads show no material1.2x gain on the tested cheap RHS workload.
families.next_action: Reopen only when batched expensive RHS cost exceeds measured synchronization/extra-sweep cost; preserve bitwise/error parity and failed attempts.
families.performance: 84 bitwise pairs,42 same-configuration thread settings; no general threading speed gain.

families.name: SABR block-GMRES / forward / nilpotent
families.scope: Declared research configurations.
families.reason: Standalone alternative block formulation is exported; current selection evidence does not establish complete-trajectory benefit over protected drivers.
families.next_action: Require original stage residual and same-error full solve against protected dense/JVP; do not use projected residual alone.

families.name: Homotopy and nonlinear / actual-K root clients
families.scope: Research root-finding; no claim that continuation automatically parallelizes time integration.
families.reason: Root/client validation is not end-to-end ODE efficiency evidence; continuation work and certification overhead must be charged.
families.next_action: Use only when a concrete nonlinear stage client beats direct protected solve at identical error; quantify continuation steps, rejected roots and all fallback work.

families.name: Transactional Q1/Q2, lagged and candidate corrections
families.scope: Experimental solver candidates; not default dispatch.
families.reason: Rollback contracts are useful infrastructure but do not themselves establish a faster selected solver.
families.next_action: Keep original residual checks and fallback; demand a nonempty winning domain before adding a selector branch.

families.name: Pexprb/exprb exponential Krylov and fused phi
families.scope: Declared smooth semilinear problems.
families.reason: Semilinear capabilities exist, but open rival/accuracy assumptions and basis/action costs prevent general adoption.
families.next_action: Use protected dense-fast and strongest applicable exact structured comparator; include phi truncation and transform work in trajectory accuracy.

families.name: Laguerre polynomial action and adjoint
families.scope: Action-level domain only; not selected general integrator.
families.reason: Component opt-in validation was published; no actual ODE speed benefit follows from a lower polynomial degree alone.
families.next_action: Reuse component proof; measure full integration only if a concrete operator/spectral enclosure predicts fewer total actions than Krylov and Chebyshev.

families.name: Leja action
families.scope: Research action; no total-binary64 certificate or default solver.
families.reason: Prior measured cost was worse than Chebyshev in the tested h*rho>=40 niche; total floating certificate remains EstimateOnly.
families.next_action: Do not repeat unchanged niche; reopen only with different admissible geometry/cost and complete operator-arithmetic bounds if certification is advertised.

families.name: Chebyshev/Taylor/Laguerre polynomial action router
families.scope: Action kernels and explicit stabilized research; no unrestricted oscillatory stabilization.
families.reason: Prior router winning niche was empty; first-order Chebyshev stability on selfadjoint negative operators is not equal-accuracy ODE speed evidence.
families.next_action: Keep kernels available; choose by validated operator domain and full cost, never by polynomial family name.

families.name: Low-degree quotient resolvent
families.scope: Declared low-degree relation with q(1) separation and witness; no autonomous selector adoption.
families.reason: Polynomial division reduces work when a valid low-degree annihilation identity holds; current provider is a two-state homogeneous collision client and is not a generic matrix solver.
families.next_action: Bind operator epoch/dimension/coefficient/norm witness; recheck original residual; integrate only with a demonstrated matching general-ODE client.
families.performance: Four published actions use1,1,2,2 operator actions; compared Neumann20success/65failure cases are kernel tests, not trajectory timing.

families.name: Unconditional Neumann inverse iteration
families.scope: Contractive declared operators only; not a global impossibility statement.
families.reason: Three tested noncontractive cases fail; a convergent-series proof requires an actual contraction bound.
families.next_action: Retain only if preconditioned norm/contraction condition is established and cheaper than safeguarded solve.

families.name: Collective low-rank / packet trajectory solvers
families.scope: Declared low-rank collective autonomous model; no automatic arbitrary-RHS routing.
families.reason: Low-rank direct action is a necessary strong comparator. Earlier packet module promotion does not establish general speed or complete floating certificates.
families.next_action: Compare against Woodbury/collective direct plus protected fast; bind exact structure and outward arithmetic before claiming certified error.

families.name: Native BDF1/BDF2 / Radau1/Radau3 references
families.scope: Reference/experimental methods, not selected user default.
families.reason: Low-order in-repo reference methods are not replacements for mature external VODE/DVODE, diffsol or Julia comparison.
families.next_action: Retain verification role; do not spend production optimization budget without a specific advantage.

families.name: Independent trajectory batching
families.scope: User-supplied independent IVPs and explicit worker budget.
families.reason: Independent trajectories can run concurrently without reducing one trajectory temporal dependency; batch throughput differs from single-thread latency.
families.next_action: Report throughput and latency separately; benchmark callback cost/ensemble size and worker overhead; no default spawned pool for one trajectory.
families.performance: Nonstiff four-configuration/sixteen-run local ensemble evidence exists; 1/2worker ratios2.10–2.39 are not a universal scaling theorem.

families.name: Fixed-point RK sweep and stage parallelization
families.scope: Theoretical/experimental stage parallelism; exact-arithmetic finite propagation is not a wall-clock guarantee.
families.reason: A sixteen-stage/four-sweep RK construction increases RHS work15 versus6 and only reduces span5 versus6; speed needs expensive parallel callbacks.
families.next_action: Reject unconditional implementation priority; calculate crossover with actual callback and synchronization cost first.

families.name: Continuous residual / global budget / affine norm support
families.scope: Optional advanced accuracy service; neither standalone ODE family nor performance candidate.
families.reason: Optional certified-error infrastructure has additional enclosure/growth assumptions; local tolerance is not a whole-trajectory guarantee. New physical budget has no general facade hook.
families.next_action: Document estimate versus bound; integrate only with typed validated bound providers; do not make application-specific physics a general-ODE release prerequisite.

families.name: RKL / Markov-Poisson / geometry subflows
families.scope: No BASS/rei research or specialized physics work in this review.
families.reason: These are problem-specific semigroup/spatial operators, not a general ODE algorithm selected by this review. Domain research is excluded from the present release denominator.
families.next_action: Retain separate research artifacts; revisit only as explicit method-of-lines clients under ordinary ODE contract.

next_actions.task: Conservative selector implemented in this work; retain focused correctness checks and review rather than reopening policy selection.
next_actions.acceptance: Selection tests prove no callback invocation, no hidden derivative route, no unsupported dense/mass/atol/event claim, and no experimental default.

next_actions.task: If resumable public solves or switching are selected for a later release, connect public persistent sessions and cache ownership; endpoint-only release does not require this optional feature.
next_actions.acceptance: Independent continuation equals uninterrupted selected-engine solve within documented tolerance; native fatal terminates promptly and retains accepted state/work.

next_actions.task: Run one preregistered current-code comparison after selector/session changes.
next_actions.acceptance: Compare DOPRI5 and protected RODAS to only VODE/DVODE,diffsol,Julia using actual error at retained outputs; preserve failed cases. Repeated interleaved timing includes setup and output costs.

next_actions.task: Reopen one structured specialization only if a concrete workload establishes a crossover.
next_actions.acceptance: Exclude timing-inconclusive LP01 as speed authority; include the strongest protected/structured baseline, all actions, failures and fallback costs.

next_actions.task: Optimize large-vector DOPRI and declared-band/JVP memory traffic.
next_actions.acceptance: Profile first; no unsafe validation removal. Retain error/finite checks and demonstrate end-to-end same-error improvement.

minimum_requirements: retained output grid and identical endpoint semantics
no pooling distinct source or timing protocols

proposed_engineering_threshold_not_theor.condition: A predeclared scoped switch must exclude losing regimes without observing the reference answer. These thresholds are proposed acceptance policy, not claims proved by existing data.

benchmark_admission.optimization_possible: A measured bottleneck has a concrete bounded fix; lack of evidence alone is HOLD/research, not speed potential.
benchmark_admission.prune_meaning: Exclude current automatic/default/mainline priority; preserve source and evidence. A new admissible workload can reopen the candidate.

critical_limits: No claim of fully derivative-free stiff general solver.
Latest LP01 cyclic timing is INCONCLUSIVE; accuracy sampling does not provide continuous phase proof.
Causal speedup baseline is residual-first coupled path, not necessarily the fastest protected solver.
No unconditional two-thread acceleration from cheap-RHS evidence.
No new measurements here; new code requires its own targeted correctness checks.

checked: Dense callback+declaredband still consumes dense resource ceiling.
ProvidedOnly refuses FD Jacobian and nonautonomous absent partial time derivative.
Matrix-free is explicit permission and inherits vector-atol refusal.
Partial selected results remain available and ensure_success returns typed failed result.
implementation_review.nonblocking_note: Resource ceiling doc should describe dense materialization as well as factorization.
implementation_review.limitations: This source review does not replace runtime tests, full numerical coverage or current performance evidence.
